# RayVo Studio

> RayVo Studio designs, programs and operates the lighting of your festivals, clubs and live events. One team, from the first idea to the last show: every event gets a lighting identity of its own.

## Site
- [RayVo Studio (English)](https://rayvo-studio.github.io/rayvo-studio/): services, work, process, contact
- [RayVo Studio (Français)](https://rayvo-studio.github.io/rayvo-studio/fr/): version française du site

## Services
- Lighting design — Technical drawings, lighting plots and 3D renders: you see the show before the event. Rig layout, equipment choices and art direction designed for the venue and the staging.
- Lighting programming — The show is written on the console: moods, sequences and effects timed precisely to the music and the staging.
- Lighting operation — Live operation on show night, with a technical crew on site from load-in to strike.
